lines.text: Late night, city lights feel cold against my skin
Scrolling through old photos, wondering where you’ve been
I tell myself I’m fine, but the silence says I’m lying
Every heartbeat hurts like it’s slowly dying
I try to let you go, but I keep pulling you closer
This empty space beside me is getting harder to shoulder
I still need you, need you here tonight
Come back and make it right, turn down these lonely lights
I’m tired of pretending I can make it on my own
I still need you… God, I still need you
I wear your favorite perfume, play the songs you used to love
Pour another glass of wine, put on the hoodie you left behind
But the truth keeps whispering underneath my breath
I’m not as strong as I said when you left
I try to let you go, but I keep pulling you closer
This empty space beside me is getting harder to shoulder
I still need you, need you here tonight
Come back and make it right, turn down these lonely lights
I’m tired of pretending I can make it on my own
I still need you… God, I still need you
If you feel it too, even just a little…
Come back to me… I’m still right here in the middle
[Final Chorus] (softer then building)
I still need you, need you here tonight
Hold me close and make the aching subside
I don’t wanna be strong if it means I’m without you
I still need you… I still need you
